title: How to reserve an experience
content: Open the CultPass app, tap Explore and pick an experience. Choose a date and tap Reserve. You will receive a confirmation email and the reservation appears under My Reservations. Each reservation uses one of your monthly experience credits. Reservations are first-come, first-served, so reserve early for popular events.

title: How to cancel a reservation
content: Go to My Reservations, open the experience and tap Cancel Reservation. Cancel at least 24 hours before the start time and your experience credit is returned immediately. Cancellations inside 24 hours, and no-shows, forfeit the credit for that month. You can also ask support to cancel a reservation for you.

title: How to cancel your subscription
content: You can cancel any time in Settings > Subscription > Cancel Subscription. Your plan stays active until the end of the current billing period and you keep access to reservations you already made. You will not be charged again after cancelling. Support can cancel for you if you cannot access the app.

title: Subscription plans and pricing
tags: plans, pricing, price, basic, premium, annual, cost
content: CultPass offers three plans. Basic costs $14.99 per month and includes 2 experiences per month. Premium costs $29.99 per month and includes 6 experiences per month. Premium Annual costs $299.99 per year with 6 experiences per month. You can switch plans in Settings > Subscription; changes apply from the next billing date.

title: Refund policy
tags: refund, money back, charge, policy, billing
content: You can request a refund within 14 days of a payment. Refunds up to $50 are approved automatically and returned to the original payment method in 5 to 10 business days. Refunds above $50, such as annual plans, need a specialist review. Payments older than 14 days and payments that were already refunded are not eligible.

title: How to update your payment method
tags: payment method, credit card, card, update, billing
content: Open Settings > Billing > Payment Method and tap Add New Card. Enter the card details and set it as default. Your next renewal is charged to the default card. For security, support can never take card numbers by chat or email.

title: Payment failed or card declined
tags: payment failed, declined, card, charge, billing error
content: A payment can fail if the card expired, has insufficient funds or the bank blocked the charge. Update your payment method in Settings > Billing. CultPass retries the charge automatically up to 3 times over 7 days. If all retries fail, your subscription is paused until a payment succeeds.

title: Download invoices and receipts
tags: invoice, receipt, download, tax, billing history
content: Go to Settings > Billing > Billing History and tap an entry to download its invoice as a PDF. Invoices are emailed automatically after every successful payment. To add a company name or tax ID to future invoices, edit them under Settings > Billing > Invoice Details.

title: Reset your password or fix login problems
tags: password, login, log in, sign in, locked out, reset, forgot
content: On the login screen tap Forgot Password and enter your email. We send a reset link that is valid for 30 minutes; check your spam folder if it does not arrive. After 5 failed attempts your account is locked for 15 minutes. If you no longer have access to your email, contact support to verify your identity.

title: Update your email address or profile
tags: email, profile, name, update, change, phone
content: Open Settings > Profile to change your name, phone number or profile photo. To change your email address, tap Change Email and confirm the link we send to the new address. Your subscription and reservations stay linked to your account when the email changes.

title: Delete your account and personal data
tags: delete account, privacy, data, gdpr, close account
content: To delete your account go to Settings > Privacy > Delete Account. Deletion removes your profile and reservation history within 30 days. Cancel any active subscription first, because deletion does not refund the current period. You can request a copy of your data from the same screen before deleting.

title: Pause your subscription
content: You can pause a subscription for 1 to 3 months in Settings > Subscription > Pause. You are not billed while paused and cannot make new reservations. Existing reservations stay valid. The subscription resumes automatically on the date you choose, or you can resume early at any time.

title: The app crashes, freezes or will not load
tags: app, crash, crashing, freeze, not loading, bug, error, slow
content: First update CultPass to the latest version from the App Store or Google Play. Then force-close the app and reopen it. If the problem continues, clear the app cache (Android) or reinstall the app (iOS); your data is stored in your account and is not lost. Contact support with your device model and app version if it still fails.

title: QR code will not scan at the venue
tags: qr code, scan, venue, check-in, ticket, entry
content: Increase your screen brightness to maximum and turn off dark mode before scanning. Make sure the app is up to date and that you are logged in to the account that holds the reservation. Your QR code is also available in My Reservations while offline. If it still fails, show the confirmation email to venue staff.

title: Not receiving notifications or emails
tags: notification, notifications, email, not receiving, push, spam
content: Check that notifications are allowed for CultPass in your phone settings and in the app under Settings > Notifications. For emails, check your spam folder and add noreply@cultpass.example to your contacts. Confirm that the email on your profile is correct and that you have not unsubscribed from marketing emails.

title: An experience was cancelled or rescheduled by the partner
tags: cancelled, rescheduled, partner, event cancelled, postponed, concert, organizer, organiser, show cancelled, event cancelled by organizer
content: If a partner cancels an experience, your credit is returned automatically and we send you an email. If it is rescheduled, your reservation moves to the new date and you can cancel for free up to 24 hours before the new start time. Cancelled experiences never count against your monthly quota.

title: Monthly experience credits and rollover
tags: credits, quota, monthly, rollover, limit, experiences per month
content: Each plan includes a number of experience credits per month: 2 on Basic and 6 on Premium plans. Credits reset on your billing date. Unused credits do not roll over to the next month. You can see your remaining credits on the home screen of the app.

title: Contact support and support hours
tags: contact, support, hours, human, agent, help
content: Our support team is available Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00 UTC. You can write to us in the app under Help > Contact Us. Most questions get a reply within 24 hours. Urgent issues such as unauthorized charges are prioritised.
